parts.label: a
parts.technique: Histogram frequency estimation
parts.reason: Uses frequency density/area relationship to estimate frequencies in a histogram, covered by S2.1 (area represents frequency).

parts.label: b
parts.technique: Median from grouped/histogram data via linear interpolation
parts.reason: Linear interpolation to find median from grouped continuous data is explicitly covered under S2.3 guidance.

parts.label: c
parts.technique: Mean from grouped frequency data
parts.reason: Calculating mean using midpoint×frequency is standard S2.3 summary statistics work.

parts.label: a
parts.technique: Calculating Sxy/Sxx type summary statistics
parts.reason: Calculating Stw and Sww from raw sums is standard summary statistic manipulation under S2.3 (Sxx formula given), not itself an excluded regression/PMCC calculation.

parts.label: b
parts.technique: PMCC calculation using formula
parts.reason: S5.1 explicitly excludes calculation of correlation coefficients using the formula (calculator use only is permitted); this question requires computing r from Stw, Sww etc., which is the excluded formula method.

parts.label: c
parts.technique: Deriving regression line equation from summary statistics
parts.reason: S2.2 explicitly excludes calculations involving regression lines.

parts.label: d
parts.technique: Interpret gradient of regression line
parts.reason: Depends on the regression line equation derived in the excluded part (c); also regression-line calculation is excluded by S2.2.

parts.label: e
parts.technique: Extrapolation danger with regression line
parts.reason: Although extrapolation concept is mentioned in S2.2, this part requires substituting into/using the excluded regression line equation from part (c), so it only makes sense after an out-of-spec part.

parts.label: f
parts.technique: PMCC under coding (invariance)
parts.reason: Relies on the excluded PMCC calculation from part (b); PMCC formula calculation is excluded under S5.1.

parts.label: g
parts.technique: Regression line equation under coding
parts.reason: Regression line calculations are explicitly excluded (S2.2) and this depends on the excluded part (c).

parts.label: a
parts.technique: Mean from coded summary statistics
parts.reason: Standard calculation of mean using coding, covered by S2.3 guidance on coding.

parts.label: b
parts.technique: Variance from coded summary statistics
parts.reason: Calculating variance via Sxx formula from summary statistics is explicitly covered by S2.3.

parts.label: c
parts.technique: Reading box plot to bound frequency in interval
parts.reason: Interpreting box plot quartiles to estimate a maximum count in an interval is covered by S2.1 (box and whisker plots).

parts.label: d
parts.technique: Outlier identification using 1.5×IQR rule
parts.reason: Explicitly matches S2.4 guidance example of using Q1-1.5×IQR and Q3+1.5×IQR to identify outliers.

parts.label: a
parts.technique: Completing a tree diagram
parts.reason: Tree diagrams for probability are explicitly listed under S3.1/S3.2.

parts.label: b
parts.technique: Probability of intersection using tree diagram
parts.reason: Standard multiplication rule via tree diagram, covered by S3.1/S3.2.

parts.label: c
parts.technique: Total probability using partition
parts.reason: Combining branch probabilities to find total probability, covered by S3.1/S3.2.

parts.label: d
parts.technique: Conditional probability (Bayes' style) via tree diagram
parts.reason: Direct application of P(A|B) formula using tree/Venn diagram information, explicitly covered by S3.2.

parts.label: a
parts.technique: Finding constant k using sum of probabilities = 1
parts.reason: This only requires that total probability sums to 1, which is basic discrete probability distribution work under S3.1/S4.1; it does not involve calculating mean or variance, so the S4.1 exclusion (mean/variance of discrete r.v.) does not apply here.

parts.label: b
parts.technique: Probability calculation P(1<Y≤4) from probability function
parts.reason: Simple summation of stated probabilities for a discrete distribution, within S4.1 scope (discrete probability distributions), not an excluded mean/variance calculation.

parts.label: c
parts.technique: E(Y) for a general discrete random variable
parts.reason: S4.1 explicitly excludes calculation of mean of discrete random variables; this is exactly that calculation.

parts.label: d
parts.technique: Probability calculation P(Y≥X) via transformed variable inequality
parts.reason: This requires forming the inequality Y≥15-2Y and summing the relevant probabilities from the given distribution — a probability calculation (S3.1/S4.1), not a mean or variance calculation, so the S4.1 exclusion of mean/variance does not apply.

parts.label: e
parts.technique: Var(X) for linear transformation of discrete random variable
parts.reason: S4.1 explicitly excludes calculation of variance of discrete random variables; this part requires Var(Y) and Var(X)=4Var(Y), directly the excluded calculation.

parts.label: a
parts.technique: Probability of union of mutually exclusive events
parts.reason: Basic use of P(A∪C)=P(A)+P(C) for mutually exclusive events, covered by S3.2.

parts.label: b
parts.technique: Conditional probability and addition rule to find P(B)
parts.reason: Uses P(B|A) formula and P(A∪B) addition rule, both explicitly covered by S3.2.

parts.label: c
parts.technique: Venn diagram construction with independent events
parts.reason: Constructing a Venn diagram with probabilities including independence condition P(A∩C)=P(A)P(C) is explicitly covered by S3.1/S3.2.

parts.label: a(i)
parts.technique: Standardising a Normal random variable to find probability
parts.reason: Direct use of Normal distribution standardisation, covered by S4.2.

parts.label: a(ii)
parts.technique: Inverse Normal calculation to find a value from given probability
parts.reason: Finding value d from probability using Normal distribution, within S4.2 scope (using calculator/tables for Normal probabilities).

parts.label: b
parts.technique: Independent repeated Normal trials probability
parts.reason: Combines independent probability events (S3.1) with Normal distribution probability (S4.2), both in spec.

parts.label: c
parts.technique: Solving simultaneous equations for Normal parameters using standardisation
parts.reason: Requires standardising with unknown mean/sd and solving simultaneous equations, explicitly anticipated by S4.2 guidance ('Questions may involve the solution of simultaneous equations').
